introHtml: Poly propylene paper hand fans offer a durable alternative to standard paper fans, resisting moisture and tearing better than traditional materials. Ideal for outdoor events, trade shows, or summer giveaways, these fans hold up in humid conditions while providing a large printable area for your logo or message. Choose from multiple sizes and full-color imprint options to create a functional promotional item that keeps your brand in hand.
